body:
Texture view selection now keeps the selected native format, dimension and device together, preserves cached-view and missing-state priorities, and retains native validation causes. The connected local changes also cover texture transfer/readback, compute observation and completion, coherent renderer simulation sources and binding ranges, and canonical card populations.

Cube shader rendering, face blits, direct face copies, 2D blits and cached-view clears now observe native creation and command recording before the separate encoder-finalization and submission checks. This adds no device wait or GPU-completion guarantee. The Cube shader programs, uniform packing, dispatch arithmetic, existing fixture oracles and shared blitter source are preserved.

Ownership of the remaining #774 functions is resolved. The #780 and #826 implementations are consuming agreed canonical contracts. Remaining work includes the complete generated-resource and physical/body/armor consumer graph, canonical schema and source-order corrections, an advection color-conversion repair, final dependency/lock composition, and complete audit waves over the combined revision.

The published head remains `d2e9f2f2984d33073386f0267a673fb7ac6478a3`. Local source checkpoints have bounded source reviews, but the combined graph is still incomplete and has no compilation or runtime verdict. No source has been pushed and no hosted checks have been requested for these repairs. Existing tests only are permitted; no tests, cases, test helpers or assertions have been added. Final clearance still requires all thirteen lenses, independent Code/Rule/Comment reviews and the required hosted project checks on one final pushed revision. This PR will not be merged by the agent.
